acceptance_criteria: Origin constants, documented: `Axis::X`, `Axis::Y`, `Axis::Z` (through the origin along +X, +Y, +Z) and `pub const ORIGIN: Point3 = [0.0; 3]`.

Work planes, each a documented function returning `Result<Workplane, KernelError>` with a normalized `x_dir` perpendicular to a normalized `normal`: `Workplane::offset(&self, distance)`: origin moved by `distance` along the normal; `x_dir` and `normal` kept. `Workplane::through_points(p0, p1, p2)`: origin `p0`, `x_dir` along `p1 − p0`, normal along `(p1 − p0) × (p2 − p0)`. `Workplane::from_point_normal(p, n)`: origin `p`, normal `n`; `x_dir` is the projection of +X onto the plane, or of +Y when `n` is within 1e-9 of parallel to X. `Workplane::angled(&self, axis: Axis, angle)`: the plane rotated by `angle` (radians, right-hand rule about `axis.dir`) about `axis`, which must lie in the plane (within 1e-9).

Work axes, returning `Result<Axis, KernelError>` with a normalized `dir`: `Axis::through_points(p, q)` (origin `p`, along `q − p`) and `Axis::plane_intersection(a: &Workplane, b: &Workplane)` (dir along `a.normal × b.normal`, origin the point of the line closest to the model origin).

Unit tests (no `occt`), points and directions within 1e-9: `Workplane::XY.offset(5.0)` has origin (0, 0, 5) and normal (0, 0, 1); `offset(−2.5)` has origin (0, 0, −2.5). `through_points((0,0,0), (10,0,0), (0,10,0))` equals `Workplane::XY`; `through_points((0,0,3), (1,0,3), (0,0,4))` has normal (0, −1, 0). `from_point_normal((1,2,3), (0,0,2))` has origin (1, 2, 3), normal (0, 0, 1), `x_dir` (1, 0, 0); with normal (5, 0, 0) its `x_dir` is (0, 1, 0). `Workplane::XY.angled(Axis::X, π/2)` has normal (0, −1, 0) and contains the X axis. `Axis::plane_intersection(&Workplane::XY.offset(4.0)?, &Workplane::YZ.offset(3.0)?)` is the line through (3, 0, 4) along ±(0, 1, 0). `plane_axis_intersection(&Workplane::XY.offset(7.0)?, &Axis::through_points((1,1,0), (2,2,1))?)` is (8, 8, 7).

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput`: non-finite inputs; coincident or collinear points (`through_points`, both kinds); a zero normal; an axis not in the plane (`angled`); parallel planes (`plane_intersection`); an axis parallel to the plane (`plane_axis_intersection`). Tolerance for "parallel" and "collinear" is a documented constant (1e-9 on unit vectors).
No new dependencies; no `unsafe`; `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M3-08a: Part origin and work-feature geometry (planes, axes, points) without OCCT
